FES Archive 6

“Forward Despite Everything,” Reich Working Group of Germany's Friends of Children, Berlin; “The German Youth Movement,” H. Ebeling; “Socialist and Vegetarian,” Franz Pirsching; “Change of Conviction” (The Education of German Youth after the World War), Minna Specht; “Experimental Schools in Germany,” Minna Specht and Alfons Rosenberg; “Address to German Youth,” Ernst Wiechert; “Youth Betrayed,” M.
